events.title: 2011: uprising and war in Syria
events.note: Protests from March 2011 turned into armed conflict. UCDP records the conflict between the government and Syrian insurgents at war level from 2011.

events.title: Türkiye's temporary protection regulation
events.note: Türkiye set out temporary protection for Syrians in a regulation, rather than granting refugee status case by case.

events.title: EU–Türkiye statement
events.note: The EU and Türkiye agreed that new irregular arrivals to the Greek islands could be returned to Türkiye, alongside EU funding for refugees in Türkiye.

events.title: Earthquakes in Türkiye and Syria
events.note: Two large earthquakes struck south-eastern Türkiye and northern Syria, where many Syrian refugees live. IDMC records the disaster displacement for both countries.

events.title: Fall of the Assad government
events.note: The government of Bashar al-Assad fell. Returns from Türkiye to Syria rose afterwards in UNHCR's returns data.

limitations.detail: Türkiye registers Syrians under temporary protection rather than full refugee status. UNHCR reports them as refugees: its notes say the figures are based on official data published by the Turkish Government, including the population under temporary protection, and that the refugee figure for Syrians in 2015 to 2018 was a government estimate.
The figures count Syrians registered with the Turkish authorities; people who are not registered are not included.

limitations.text: Earthquake displacement is a separate series
limitations.detail: People displaced by the February 2023 earthquakes are counted by IDMC as disaster displacement inside Türkiye and Syria. Those figures are not part of the refugee totals here and are never added to them.

missing_why.unregistered Syrians: the figures count only Syrians registered with the Turkish authorities; no open dataset counts the rest.

refugees.reliability: Türkiye registers Syrians under temporary protection, and UNHCR reports the government's registration figures; people who never registered are not in them.
